  - paragraph: The menu allows calibration, authorization and paint color. All eight subsets were checked. Neither no repair nor paint alone helps. Calibration alone leaves W10/W11 unresolved; authorization alone leaves W01/W11 unresolved. Both dependencies suffice. Adding paint as well is redundant.
  - paragraph:
    - strong: Calibration plus authorization is the unique globally minimal repair, with two menu entries.
    - text: This minimum applies only to these four worlds and this menu. It is not a universal minimum, shortest encoding or claim that every individual decision needs both fields.
